mechanism_claims.claim_text: Selected lipopeptides L2, C2, L4, and C4 directly permeabilized the outer membrane of E. coli ML-35 in the CENTA beta-lactamase assay at MIC-level concentrations tested in the paper.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; E. coli ML-35 outer membrane assay only

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.4:Permeabilization of E. coli ML-35 Membranes

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct OM result is limited to the four selected peptides and E. coli ML-35 assay conditions; it is not row-level evidence for every peptide in Tables 2-4.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Selected lipopeptides L2, C2, L4, and C4 directly permeabilized the inner membrane of E. coli ML-35 in the ONPG beta-galactosidase assay, with faster IM permeabilization reported for C2 versus L2 and for C4 versus L4 at the supported concentration context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; E. coli ML-35 inner membrane assay only

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.4:Permeabilization of E. coli ML-35 Membranes

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct IM result is kinetic/assay-specific and should not be generalized to untested peptide-organism pairs.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Selected lipopeptides L2, C2, L4, and C4 caused membrane depolarization consistent with membrane damage in DiSC3(5) fluorescence assays for C. albicans, E. coli, and S. aureus surfaces documented in the main figure and local supplement.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; C. albicans ATCC 10231 plus bacterial supplementary DiSC3(5) assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: The main text reports C. albicans in Figure 6 and routes E. coli/S. aureus traces to local supplement figures; exact curve digitization was not required for ontology classification.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fluorescence microscopy with FM 1-43 and propidium iodide supports direct C. albicans membrane permeabilization by selected lipopeptides L2, C2, L4, and C4.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; C. albicans ATCC 10231 fluorescence microscopy

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.8:Visualization of Candida albicans Cells Treated with Selected Lipopeptides by Fluorescence Microscopy and Transmission Electron Microscopy

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct microscopy evidence is qualitative and limited to the selected peptides and C. albicans cells.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Transmission electron microscopy supports selected lipopeptide-induced C. albicans ultrastructural damage, including membrane detachment/invagination and intracellular vesicle/vacuole changes under the reported treatment conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; C. albicans ATCC 10231 TEM

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.8:Visualization of Candida albicans Cells Treated with Selected Lipopeptides by Fluorescence Microscopy and Transmission Electron Microscopy

mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM is qualitative morphology evidence and does not by itself quantify concentration-response mechanism for all peptide variants.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations support membrane binding, peptide insertion or micelle association, lipid-domain enrichment, and local membrane-thickness/APL perturbation for selected lipopeptides in bacterial and fungal membrane models.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2, C2, L4, C4; bacterial and fungal model membranes in CG MD simulations
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational evidence supports membrane-interaction plausibility but is not promoted to direct experimental mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MIC, MBEC, and MBIC tables establish antimicrobial and antibiofilm phenotypes for the lipopeptide panel, but those activity endpoints are not direct mechanism assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: All L1-C7 lipopeptides in XML Tables 2-4
mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity/toxicity phenotype rows belong to worker-2 evidence and should not be interpreted as membrane mechanism without the direct assays above.

source_review.classification_policy: Direct experimental membrane assays were classified as direct_mechanism; MIC/MBEC/MBIC activity phenotypes remain phenotype_supported; CG MD remains computational_only.
